caption: The drawing features two outlines of ornamental hair combs, one larger and positioned toward the bottom center, and one smaller placed above it toward the upper right. Both combs have wide, curved tops and multiple long, pointed teeth hanging downward. The upper comb is rendered solely in thin black outline and contains a rectangular inset on its curved upper section filled with a floral pattern of swirling leaves and flowers. The lower comb is more detailed and partially colored; its left side and upper edge are filled with brown and dark brown hues, which blend into a creamy yellow in the central and lower portions. The colored sections of this comb are overlaid with a detailed floral design in white and yellow outlines, corresponding to the pattern in the upper comb, with leafy and flowery motifs extending across the surface. The right portion of the lower comb, including some teeth, is only outlined in black with no color fill. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light cream color.
title: Comb
